in_sanskrit.name: कुमुद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kumud is derived from the Sanskrit word कुमुद (kumuda), which means lotus. The lotus is a symbol of purity, beauty, and divine grace in Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: कुमुद
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kumud is also used in Hindi, and its meaning remains the same: lotus.

in_tamil.name: குமுத
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Kumud is written as குமுத (kumudam), and its meaning is lotus.

in_telugu.name: కుముద
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Kumud is written as కుముద (kumudam), and its meaning remains the same: lotus.

in_marathi.name: Kumud
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumud हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Symbolizes the radiant beauty and warmth of the sun, and is often associated with the goddess Lakshmi. Kumud is the name of the lotus flower, and is a symbol of purity, grace, and spiritual growth.
